detail.question: Quels sont les dix produits les plus vendus, en nombre d'articles ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH ventes_par_produit AS (
    SELECT
        oi.product_id AS produit_id,
        p.product_category_name AS categorie,
        COUNT(*) AS nombre_articles
    FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
    LEFT JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
        ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    GROUP BY oi.product_id, p.product_category_name
)
SELECT produit_id,
       categorie,
       nombre_articles
FROM ventes_par_produit
ORDER BY nombre_articles DESC
LIMIT 10;

detail.question: Quelles sont les dix categories de produits qui rapportent le plus, en euros ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH revenue_par_categorie AS (
    SELECT p.product_category_name AS categorie,
           SUM(oi.price) AS revenu_euros
    FROM entrepot."order_items" oi
    JOIN entrepot."orders" o
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN entrepot."products" p
      ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY p.product_category_name
)
SELECT categorie,
       revenu_euros
FROM revenue_par_categorie
ORDER BY revenu_euros DESC
LIMIT 10;

detail.question: Combien de commandes par mois en 2017 ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH commandes_2017 AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts,
        o.order_id
    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
    WHERE TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) IS NOT NULL
      AND EXTRACT(year FROM TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP)) = 2017
)
SELECT
    STRFTIME(ts, '%Y-%m') AS mois,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes
FROM commandes_2017
GROUP BY mois
ORDER BY mois
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quel est le chiffre d'affaires mois par mois en 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH commandes_2018 AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS purchase_ts
    FROM entrepot."orders"
    WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
)
SELECT
    TO_CHAR(purchase_ts, 'YYYY-MM') AS mois,
    SUM(oi.price) AS chiffre_affaires
FROM commandes_2018 c
JOIN entrepot."order_items" oi USING (order_id)
GROUP BY mois
ORDER BY mois
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quel jour de la semaine recoit le plus de commandes ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH achats AS (
    SELECT TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS ts
    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
)
SELECT 
    CASE EXTRACT(DOW FROM ts)
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Dimanche'
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Lundi'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'Mardi'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'Mercredi'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'Jeudi'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'Vendredi'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'Samedi'
    END AS jour_semaine,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_commandes
FROM achats
WHERE ts IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY jour_semaine
ORDER BY nb_commandes DESC
LIMIT 1;

detail.question: A quelle heure de la journee nos clients commandent-ils le plus ?

    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o

detail.question: Quel chiffre d'affaires par etat du client ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH revenue_par_etat AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_state AS etat_client,
        SUM(oi.price) AS chiffre_affaires
    FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
    JOIN entrepot."orders" AS o
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN entrepot."customers" AS c
        ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    -- On ne compte que les ventes réellement livrées
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
    GROUP BY c.customer_state
)

       chiffre_affaires
FROM revenue_par_etat
ORDER BY chiffre_affaires DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quelles categories de produits ont le panier moyen le plus eleve, avec leur nom en anglais ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH filtered_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id
    FROM entrepot."orders"
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
),
order_category AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id,
           p.product_category_name,
           SUM(oi.price) AS revenue_category
    FROM entrepot."order_items" oi
    JOIN entrepot."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN filtered_orders fo ON oi.order_id = fo.order_id
    GROUP BY oi.order_id, p.product_category_name
),
category_avg AS (
    SELECT oc.product_category_name,
           AVG(oc.revenue_category) AS panier_moyen
    FROM order_category oc
    GROUP BY oc.product_category_name
)
SELECT pct.product_category_name_english AS categorie_anglais,
       ca.panier_moyen
FROM category_avg ca
JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" pct
  ON ca.product_category_name = pct.product_category_name
ORDER BY ca.panier_moyen DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Les vendeurs de quels etats livrent le plus vite ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH delivery_times AS (
    SELECT 
        s.seller_state,
        DATE_DIFF('day',
            TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP),
            TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP)
        ) AS delivery_days
    FROM entrepot."order_items" oi
    JOIN entrepot."orders" o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN entrepot."sellers" s ON oi.seller_id = s.seller_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    seller_state AS etat_vendeur,
    AVG(delivery_days) AS duree_moyenne_jours
FROM delivery_times
GROUP BY seller_state
ORDER BY duree_moyenne_jours ASC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quelle est la note moyenne par categorie de produit, en anglais, pour les categories evaluees au moins cinq cents fois ?

WITH reviews_par_categorie AS (
    SELECT
        pcnt.product_category_name_english AS categorie,
        r.review_score
    FROM entrepot."order_reviews" r
    JOIN entrepot."orders" o ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN entrepot."order_items" oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
    JOIN entrepot."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" pcnt
        ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
)
SELECT
    categorie,
    AVG(review_score) AS note_moyenne,
    COUNT(*) AS nb_evaluations
FROM reviews_par_categorie
GROUP BY categorie

ORDER BY note_moyenne DESC

detail.question: Les commentaires des clients mecontents sont-ils plus longs que ceux des clients satisfaits ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH commentaires AS (
  SELECT
    review_score,
    LENGTH(review_comment_message) AS longueur
  FROM entrepot."order_reviews"
  WHERE review_comment_message IS NOT NULL AND review_comment_message <> ''
)
SELECT
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN longueur END) AS moyenne_longueur_insatisfaits,
  AVG(CASE WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN longueur END) AS moyenne_longueur_satisfaits,
  CASE 
    WHEN AVG(CASE WHEN review_score <= 2 THEN longueur END) > AVG(CASE WHEN review_score >= 4 THEN longueur END) THEN 'Oui, les commentaires insatisfaits sont plus longs'
    ELSE 'Non, les commentaires satisfaits sont plus longs ou les longueurs sont égales'
  END AS comparaison
FROM commentaires
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quel pourcentage de commandes arrive en retard par rapport a la date estimee ?

detail.question: Le delai de livraison depend-il de l'etat du client ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH livraison AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_state AS etat,
        TRY_CAST(o.order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) - TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS interval_delai
    FROM entrepot."orders" o
    JOIN entrepot."customers" c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
      AND o.order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    etat,
    AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM interval_delai) / 86400.0) AS delai_moyen_jours,
    COUNT(*) AS nombre_commandes
FROM livraison
GROUP BY etat
ORDER BY delai_moyen_jours DESC
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Le chiffre d'affaires du second semestre 2017 est-il superieur a celui du premier ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH orders_2017 AS (
    SELECT o.order_id,
           TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS achat_ts
    FROM entrepot."orders" AS o
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01'
      AND TRY_CAST(o.order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) <  TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
),
order_items AS (
    SELECT oi.order_id,
           oi.price
    FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.achat_ts) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN i.price END) AS chiffre_affaires_premier_semestre,
    SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.achat_ts) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN i.price END) AS chiffre_affaires_second_semestre,
    CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.achat_ts) BETWEEN 7 AND 12 THEN i.price END) >
              SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.achat_ts) BETWEEN 1 AND 6 THEN i.price END)
         THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS superieur_second_semestre
FROM orders_2017 AS o
JOIN order_items AS i ON o.order_id = i.order_id
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Combien de commandes en janvier 2018 contre janvier 2017 ?

WITH commandes_jan AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_achat,
        order_id
    FROM entrepot."orders"
    WHERE (
        TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01 00:00:00' AND

detail.question: Le delai de livraison moyen a-t-il change entre 2017 et 2018 ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH dates AS (
    SELECT
        TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS purchase_ts,
        TRY_CAST(order_delivered_customer_date AS TIMESTAMP) AS delivery_ts
    FROM entrepot."orders"
    WHERE order_status = 'delivered'
      AND order_purchase_timestamp IS NOT NULL
      AND order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL
),
delays AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(year FROM purchase_ts) AS annee,
        DATEDIFF('day', purchase_ts, delivery_ts) AS delai_jours
    FROM dates
    WHERE purchase_ts IS NOT NULL AND delivery_ts IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    annee AS annee,
    ROUND(AVG(delai_jours), 2) AS delai_moyen_jours
FROM delays
WHERE annee IN (2017, 2018)
GROUP BY annee
ORDER BY annee
LIMIT 1000;

detail.question: Quel trimestre de 2018 a le mieux marche en volume ?
detail.sql_produit:
WITH orders_2018 AS (
       SELECT order_id,
              TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) AS purchase_ts
       FROM entrepot."orders"
       WHERE TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) >= TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01'
         AND TRY_CAST(order_purchase_timestamp AS TIMESTAMP) < TIMESTAMP '2019-01-01'
     ),
     items_par_trimestre AS (
       SELECT DATE_TRUNC('quarter', o.purchase_ts) AS trimestre,
              COUNT(*) AS volume_items
       FROM entrepot."order_items" oi
       JOIN orders_2018 o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
       GROUP BY trimestre
     )
SELECT TO_CHAR(trimestre, 'YYYY-"Q"Q') AS trimestre,
       volume_items
FROM items_par_trimestre
ORDER BY volume_items DESC
LIMIT 1;

detail.question: Quelle marge realisons-nous sur chaque categorie de produits ?
detail.sql_produit:
SELECT
  pcnt.product_category_name AS categorie_produit,
  SUM(oi.price - oi.freight_value) AS marge_totale
FROM entrepot."order_items" AS oi
JOIN entrepot."products" AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN entrepot."product_category_name_translation" AS pcnt
  ON p.product_category_name = pcnt.product_category_name
GROUP BY pcnt.product_category_name
ORDER BY marge_totale DESC
LIMIT 1000;
